items.title: South Korean shares close at over 9-month low on Nvidia caution
items.content: South Korean shares experienced a significant decline of more than 2% amid concerns affecting chipmakers. The benchmark KOSPI closed at its lowest level since February due to persistent selling pressure. Foreign investors were noted as net sellers of shares worth approximately 1.4 trillion won. The Korean won weakened slightly against the dollar during this trading period. Additionally, South Korea's benchmark bond yields fell as market activities shifted.

items.title: New wearable ultrasound patch boosts REM sleep without drugs or surgery
items.content: A revolutionary new wearable patch could help people get more restorative sleep without medication or surgery. Developed by University of Texas researchers, the device uses gentle ultrasound to stimulate deep brain regions, helping participants enter REM sleep 43 minutes faster and remain there 16 minutes longer on average. The technology also showed promising effects on stress regulation and brain circuits involved in emotion.
